story.vex: A target on paper means nothing until reality tests it. Let's test it. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED before it started: every recovery event is checked honestly against the plan's own targets. Astro: "The plan is only as good as what it actually does under pressure."

files.C:\\Citadel\\README.txt:
ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Read dr-plan.txt for the targets, then recovery-log.txt for three real events. Classify each event as within-target or exceeded-target.

1. type dr-plan.txt
2. type recovery-log.txt
3. classify <event> within-target | exceeded-target

steps.title: Read the plan and the log
steps.body: Astro: "Know the targets before you judge the events." `type dr-plan.txt`, then `type recovery-log.txt`.

steps.title: Check each event against the targets
steps.body: Astro: "Downtime under 4 hours and data loss under 1 hour both meet target. Either one exceeded is a miss." Classify all three events.
